form.category: Manicure and pedicure, gel and nail art
form.differentiator: Every session is private. You get the whole studio and the whole appointment to yourself, and the set is designed for you rather than picked off a menu.
form.undercut_on: I am one person with limited slots, and my prices are not published so customers have to enquire before they know what they are paying.
form.their_price_point: See the derived competitive set for the category ladder.
